description: Source code for the Zephyr driver for the Hamamatsu S11059 sensor, including initialization, measurement, and data conversion functions.

methods.name: s11059_convert_channel_to_index
methods.description: Converts sensor channel enum to internal index for data array.

methods.name: s11059_samples_read
methods.description: Reads sensor samples over I2C from specified address.

methods.name: s11059_control_write
methods.description: Writes control byte to sensor via I2C.

methods.name: s11059_manual_timing_write
methods.description: Sets manual integration timing via I2C.

methods.name: s11059_start_measurement
methods.description: Initiates a measurement cycle on the sensor.

methods.name: s11059_integ_time_calculate
methods.description: Calculates manual timing and mode based on desired integration time.

methods.name: s11059_channel_get
methods.description: Converts raw samples to sensor_value for a specific channel.

methods.name: s11059_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, sets gain and integration time.
